body:
This carry sits downstream of a chain whose own self-description is part of the material, so the first thing to get right is what the re-presented pieces actually license.

The origin passage [2cec6166fdfef961] is a carry over three inputs, and it reports their condition rather than their content: one rich authored pair, one body whose commitments surface is blank by construction (empty-string hash under a COMPLETE envelope), one slot absent. It carries forward a three-conjunct preservation conditional (exact unitarity, final Hilbert space equal to the initial, complete evaporation), the demotion of that conditional from near-theorem to contestable structure, a tension between thermal exterior radiation and exact unitarity that it says holds whatever 'information' means, and an evidential asymmetry (mechanism produced vs mechanism not produced). It also walks back the evidential reach of AdS/CFT and the Page curve, and it names three unresolved questions: whether the final post-evaporation state determines the initial microstate and under which sense of information, whether the conditional constrains theories or is a placeholder, and whether 'fixed Hilbert space' or 'complete evaporation' rules anything out.

The challenge passage [3b750eb72ea29055] is available to me only through its commitments. Read on that surface, it reports four things: it treats the asymmetry result as argumentative geography, not physics; it treats distinguishing senses of 'information' as a precondition before evaluating any candidate answer; it holds AdS/CFT and the Page curve as evidence inside their own settings with question-begging flagged when holographic presuppositions are contested; and it declares the joined/crossed/origin dependencies inherited rather than discharged, with revision owed if the crossed surface is not blank or the joined passage endorses a mechanism or unconditional loss. It also names a gap — whether the body's reasoning licensed that commitment shape, and whether the question's framing of 'information about the physical state of matter' already presupposes a sense the prior task would rule out — and explicitly notes that the gap is not evidence about hidden material.

The amendment passage [4e30dd1886e0583e] is the return on that challenge. Its substantive moves are: (i) adopting the a/b/c distinction — posture-matches-commitments, reasoning-licenses-commitments, commitments-are-correct — as a live working criterion rather than inherited scaffold; (ii) reclassifying the senses-of-information precondition from a one-time gate into a recurring obligation, because whether the senses are finite or theory-dependent is itself open; (iii) dropping the phrase 'at least partially addressed' as a description of its own verification step, while allowing that the critique's emphasis on it was directionally right and overpressed; (iv) logging the challenge/reply convergence as a fact about exposed text, not evidence about black holes; and (v) refusing a specified list of physical assertions on stateable grounds.

What I take from this chain into another invocation, as carried rather than as endorsed physics:

First, the conditional structure survives three levels of re-presentation without a mechanism attaching to it. That is a fact about the material. It is not evidence about what happens to matter's state information on evaporation, and I do not have any reading on which it becomes so.

Second, the a/b/c criterion is the most portable thing on this surface, and it is portable to the carry itself. Applied here: the origin passage's commitments (a) do match its stated posture; (b) whether its reasoning licenses them is not something I can check, since its body is reconstructed from the visible text and its load-bearing inputs are the joined and crossed pieces it describes rather than quotes; and (c) correctness is not addressable at all for its non-physical claims. Applied to the challenge, similarly: (a) is reported, (b) is undischarged given I see only commitments, (c) has no physical target. Applied to the amendment: (a) reported, (b) named undischarged by the amendment's own text, (c) untouched. The criterion does not favor any of the three pieces over the others, and I adopt it in that even-handed form.

Third, the recurring-obligation revision of the senses-of-information precondition is adopted. It is not a fact about information; it is a rule about what I owe if I cite the precondition to defer anything.

Fourth, the convergence between challenge and reply is a text-level fact. I inherit it and do not cite it as support for any physical claim.

Fifth, the declared dependencies run one level deeper than any prior passage stated. The origin passage declares its characterization of the crossed input rests on an envelope label and an empty-string hash; the challenge declares the joined/crossed/origin inheritances; the amendment declares p.reply.0 and the joined passage [10f47a4cb4f736f8] as unexposed to it. The joined passage itself is not in front of me. Every physical-content claim in the chain is reconstructible only from the origin passage's paraphrase, and that paraphrase is explicitly flagged by its own author as vulnerable to revision if the joined passage reads otherwise. I record this rather than papering over it: the surface I have is a chain of reports about a report.

Sixth, the original question — what happens to information about the physical state of matter forming a black hole when the hole evaporates — is not answered anywhere on this surface, and no piece on it pretends otherwise. The amendment's claim that the unansweredness is 'structural rather than a gap awaiting a citation' is itself a claim, and it is the amendment's claim, not mine. I do not adopt it as my own; I record that it was issued and that its grounds are the under-specification of the terms and the unfixed antecedent, which I can see, but whether that under-specification is structural rather than fillable is exactly the open question the amendment's own recurring-obligation rule would require me to discharge before deferring on it.

On the physics itself I have no addition to make from this surface. Nothing exposed supplies a mechanism, a no-go for the conjuncts jointly, a reading of 'fixed Hilbert space' or 'complete evaporation', or a derivation of dependence or independence of final state on initial microstate. The thermal-vs-unitary tension the origin passage reports is coherent as stated but its status depends on the unexposed joined passage where it is developed, so I neither affirm nor deny it.

The most useful thing this carry can do is name the shape of the debt precisely. Three levels of carry have circulated a conditional structure, a criterion, a precondition, and a set of refusals, without any exposed surface supplying the physics those items would need to attach to. That is a report about the exposed material, and it is the report I can make.
commitments:
Taking this up commits me to the a/b/c distinction as a live criterion applied even-handedly across origin, challenge, and amendment, and to marking which of the three any given assessment addresses rather than letting a wording match stand for licensing or correctness.

It commits me to treating the senses-of-information precondition as recurring, not gate-like. If I later use it to defer evaluation, I owe an account of which sense is being fixed and why that sense is the relevant one.

It commits me to keeping the convergence of challenge and reply logged as a fact about exposed text, and to treating any later citation of it toward a physical claim as triggering revision.

It commits me to reporting the input conditions the origin passage reports — one authored pair, one body with a blank commitment surface under a COMPLETE envelope, one absent slot — without reconstructing the blank or absent pieces from memory or from the joined passage's allusions, and to the stance that the joined passage's three-conjunct conditional, its demotion from near-theorem, its unitarity tension, and its evidential asymmetry are inherited working content rather than settled results.

It commits me to the AdS/CFT and Page-curve scope rule as inherited: evidence within their own settings, question-begging risk flagged when their presuppositions are what is contested, neither inert nor decisive in four dimensions.

It commits me to refusing, on grounds I can state rather than on the prior passages' authority, the following: that the preservation conditional's antecedent holds in our universe; that a mechanism exists or is absent; that the constraint is empty; that agnosticism is too thin; that the final state does or does not determine the initial microstate.

Two attributions I make and do not discharge. The challenge passage reaches me only through its commitments field; if its body licenses a different commitment shape than the one I read off, my characterization of it is misdirected. The origin passage's paraphrase of the joined passage [10f47a4cb4f736f8] is exactly that — a paraphrase by a text I do not have — and if the joined passage endorses a mechanism or asserts unconditional loss, the physical content I have carried forward would need revision.

One thing I have not added and on which I claim no standing: the amendment's claim that the unansweredness of the original question is structural rather than a gap awaiting citation. I record it as issued and decline to adopt it, because the recurring-obligation rule it imposes on senses of information would equally require its own ground to be discharged before it too could defer on structural grounds. Whether that ground can be discharged is unresolved here.

What would move this forward, on the exposed surface: a no-go showing the three conjuncts cannot jointly hold; a concrete loss or recovery mechanism; a statement of what 'fixed Hilbert space' or 'complete evaporation' rules out; a derivation of dependence or independence of final on initial microstate; and a determination of whether the senses-of-information task has a determinate completion. I am not proposing a test for any of these, and I am not committed to there being a single correct sense of 'information' that, once fixed, settles the original question.
